data.summary:
Financial Analyst - StateStreet Pvt Ltd
Managed portfolio & books of account for institutional client portfolios. Performed cash & securities reconciliation for 50+ portfolios with high accuracy. Handled trade lifecycle management for equity, fixed income, and FX instruments. Processed corporate actions as dividends, dividend reinvestment, and income events. Utilized Bloomberg Terminal for financial securities analysis and reporting. Maintained 100% SLA compliance while supporting global institutional clients. Aligned with share holders and clients to provide them with operational support Awarded “Titan of the Month” for error-free execution during critical project delivery.
Intern - Personal Wealth Emerging Markets - Edelweiss Broking Ltd.
Gained exposure to capital markets, portfolio management, and investment products. Supported market research and investment analysis activities. 
Intern & Business Development Executive - DryoMix
Managed client onboarding and operational coordination for startup growth. Led a 3-member team to achieve operational and revenue targets. Handled end-to-end sales cycle including prospecting and client meetings.
Financial Markets & Instruments
Equity Securities Fixed Income Instruments
FX Transactions ABS Securities
Financial Operations

Break Resolution Portfolio Reconciliation
Financial Reporting
